entities.summary: Jaime Serra Palou is a Catalan artist and journalist, specialized in infographics and data visualization design. He is the Director of Infographics and Illustration at La Vanguardia newspaper since October 2007, where since 2010 he publishes a column called A Sunday Paradox.
